prompt:
Create ONE grayscale material-blend CONTROL MAP for the complete source ground image. This is an artist-authored proposed grass-versus-soil weight map, not final ground artwork, not a height map and not an automatic extraction claim.

The single reference is the COMPLETE original96x64ground frame enlarged exactly6x with nearest-neighbor sampling. Preserve the full3:2window and the source's left-soil/right-grass distribution and irregular sparse mixed band. Output576x384, fully opaque, neutral grayscale only (R=G=B), with no border or extra space.

Meaning: black=compacted-soil material only; white=short-grass material only; intermediate gray=proposed fractional grass coverage in a genuinely mixed region. Gray does NOT mean uncertain/confidence, lighting, a bump or an elevation. The source reference's brightness, shadows, individual grains and tiny color noise must not be copied as grayscale intensity. Read material-region membership, not luminance. No ground colors or material textures are requested; those will come from separate already-generated world-coordinate textures.

In original96x64coordinates, the broad region x0..22 is clearly soil-dominant and x74..95 is clearly grass-dominant, throughout the height. Keep those interiors respectively black/near-black and white/near-white. The central x23..73region is visually ambiguous mixed material: propose a spatially coherent irregular grass coverage progression guided by the actual source, with sparse incursions and natural nonstraight transition, but no new isolated islands, road, track, large stone or invented shape. Do not simply make a linear left-to-right gradient. Avoid salt-and-pepper weights or mapping each tiny original RGB grain independently.

Grass enters from the right side. Both top and bottom edges run from soil on the left through a broad mixed interval into grass on the right. Preserve source-specific differences between the top and bottom transition rather than mirroring or forcing opposite edges identical. The left edge remains soil-dominant and right edge grass-dominant. Do not change a source edge to accommodate any unseen neighboring frame. This is one particular source-local boundary control, not a universal seamless tile.

Return only the complete opaque neutral-gray control image, with no labels, text, color, legend, grid, outlines, decorative texture, light gradient, cast shadow or perspective. Do not draw grass blades or gravel into the map. Do not crop, zoom, rotate, mirror or recenter. If another output resolution is necessary, scale the ENTIRE3:2window uniformly. The central proposed coverage will be reviewed manually as a hypothesis against source context; do not suggest that this map establishes exact ownership, height, collision or walkability.
